summary: The knowledge-mode dossiers are broadly right on roster, coach, owner, arena funding, record, Cup and marquee facts, all of which match CURRENT FACTS. The real errors: the pinwheel designer was Frank Glickman, not Cooney (confirmed live). The downtown Nike store closed in late 2023 and reopened Nov 2025 at 638 SW 5th Ave. Deadstock Coffee moved to The Hoxton. Spirit of 77 had a neighborhood mismatch, the Camara and Holiday trade line was off, and the Blazers are not the only major-league basketball team in the state. The Nike Hoop Summit at Moda Center was confirmed live for April 2026. The brief needs three fixes: the White Stag timing, the Cooney verify item, and hedges on the Nike downtown channel and the 1977 Classic Edition. The remaining risk sits in small-business, date and licensing claims.
